changelog.text: Existing source citations now link to the original PDFs and textbook entries on the Sources page.
Added consistent syntax highlighting to C, Java and pseudocode snippets, with readable colors in light/dark themes and offline downloads.
Units 3–5 rebuilt for the new syllabus: Queues is now Unit 3, Trees is Unit 4 (threaded trees moved in), Heaps merged into Unit 5 with B-trees, BFS/DFS and graph applications added.
Lab programs added: Josephus, loop detection, polynomial subtraction, sparse matrix multiplication (Unit 1); prefix evaluation and iterative Tower of Hanoi (Unit 2).
Corrected: threaded-tree thread lists, a max-heap insertion figure, the standard vs compressed trie figure, and the B+ tree construction trace.
Units 1–2 re-aligned to the new syllabus (linked lists moved to Unit 1, stacks to Unit 2).
